commercialPurpose: Give editorial and lifestyle sites a calm brand-first entry with utility access that supports browsing without product-app pressure.
purposeLayer: Navigation establishes a personal editorial brand mood before the user enters posts, categories, or social/search controls.
anatomyLayer: Centered signature/logo mark, quiet horizontal menu, small top or edge social icons, search control, and minimal utility actions.
hierarchyLayer: Brand mark first, primary menu second, search/social utilities third.
gridRhythmLayer: Thin full-width utility rail above or beside a centered brand block; navigation spacing is wide and low-density.
densityLimitLayer: Use 4-7 nav links, 0-1 search control, and 2-5 small social or utility icons; avoid heavy button clusters.
originalityLayer: Learn brand-first editorial navigation logic only; do not copy script logo shape, exact menu labels, or icon placement.
usageRuleLayer: Use for editorial, creator, boutique magazine, and lifestyle templates; avoid as primary nav for SaaS dashboards or high-conversion apps.
layoutGesture: centered brand signature with thin utility rail
sectionSilhouette: air-heavy header with logo peak and low-profile navigation line
compositionTension: emotional brand center balanced by tiny functional controls at the edges
focalPath: logo signature to menu row to search/social utilities
negativeSpaceShape: wide white cap around a narrow navigation spine
depthLayering: flat editorial surface with subtle divider hierarchy
moduleScaleVariation: large brand mark against tiny navigation utilities
breakoutBehavior: none; navigation stays quiet and contained
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact script logo, top social icon rhythm, menu text, or minimal gold accent placement.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint learning is visually inspected but not yet promoted to stable PASS; keep as incoming review vocabulary.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
